name: Android SDK Platform-Tools
version_policy: Google no longer publishes versioned archives for current platform-tools releases; only the -latest- URL serves them. The build therefore requires at least minimum_version rather than asserting an exact match, which would fail every time Google ships an update, and records the version actually downloaded in platform-tools/bundled_version.txt.
license: Android Software Development Kit License Agreement
system_path_policy: Never modify system-wide ADB installations or environment variables.
